figures.alt: Empty commercial cold-storage room with insulated metal wall panels, sealed joints, refrigeration lines, and insulated doorway
figures.caption: Florida cold storage depends on a continuous insulated and vapor-controlled enclosure. Panel joints, penetrations, doors, and refrigeration coordination have to control heat and moisture together.

figures.alt: Insulated cold-storage door threshold with sealed panel base, protective curb detail, and smooth floor transition
figures.caption: Freezer floor and doorway details are part of the thermal boundary. Slab, insulation, transitions, equipment paths, and durable protection need to work as one assembly.
figures.before: Slab Design: Freeze Protection is Mandatory for Freezer Facilities

figures.alt: Commercial cold-room ceiling with insulated panels, refrigeration evaporator unit, supported lines, and vapor-tight transition
figures.caption: Refrigeration coordination reaches beyond the equipment. Ceiling panels, supports, piping, drains, service access, penetrations, and the surrounding envelope need to be resolved before turnover.
